release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 现场交通与无障碍复核能否证明班车窗口不会切断公共路线？
release_readout.stop_condition: Stop and return to metro, bus and human guidance if the accessible route or fire clearance is interrupted.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 责任人、清场时限和投诉回写是否已经在现场可执行？
release_readout.stop_condition: Hold the window if delivery or visitor queues spill into the accessible route or public road.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 最慢群体和夜间回家链是否比全体平均值更安全？
release_readout.stop_condition: Stop feeder expansion when return-home coverage or accessible transfer worsens.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 谁在末班车、照明、维修和拒载时段承担现场接手？
release_readout.stop_condition: Hold the night window when a staffed and accessible return path is not documented.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 儿童、照护者和轮椅使用者是否拥有同等清晰的替代路线？
release_readout.stop_condition: Hold any curb change when the accessible route is longer, less safe or dependent on a digital account.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 服务台能否在高峰时段解释、记录并纠正一次冲突？
release_readout.stop_condition: Stop a booking rule if it displaces an urgent care trip or blocks the public route.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 分组导流是否减少最弱群体的等待与绕行，而非只减少车辆排队？
release_readout.stop_condition: Stop if the accessible or child-safe route loses priority during the release window.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 夜间回家链是否有可见的责任人、替代路线和退出条件？
release_readout.stop_condition: Stop if the night route lacks lighting, human handoff or an accessible alternative.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 维护者是否先发布正式锚定关系，再允许任何站口空间动作？
release_readout.stop_condition: Hold all geometry-led action until the key-area anchor and station relation are formally confirmed.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 临时关系线能否支持调查而不诱导错误的站点建设结论？
release_readout.stop_condition: Hold any fixed intervention if the geometry or public-space ownership remains unclear.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 轨道优先、居民回家和无障碍连续性是否在同一时段都被保住？
release_readout.stop_condition: Hold feeder or event changes when external OD and the worst-group route are not measured.

release_readout.human_decision_question_zh: 正式锚点、末班车回退和夜间安全责任是否同时成立？
release_readout.stop_condition: Hold the night action when any anchor, service, safety or human handoff is missing.
